steps.text:
The curved handle is built and passes the plan check: a 12 mm round bar with two straight 15 mm posts, 128 mm center to center, arching 30 mm above the post ends (51 mm overall height from the drawer front), and an M4 clearance hole (4.5 mm, 10 mm deep) in the mounting end of each post. It is watertight, with a minimum wall of 3.75 mm.

The post length and the 10 mm hole depth were my guesses, and the arch rise is measured from the post ends. The arch is a smooth spline rather than a true circular arc, because a true arc cannot meet the straight posts tangentially at this rise. The part is still off the bed, so it needs placing before slicing.

I haven't sliced or sent it to the P1S. Do you want it arranged on the plate and sliced for the P1S in PLA?
